limits: The appender requires the exact three-page schema image and one-page table/index leaf roots; it cross-checks each current index entry against the corresponding table row.
Rowids are limited to 1..127; page splits, overflow cells, freelist handling, and arbitrary existing database layouts refuse.
This remains a bounded in-memory image mutation plus FS2 file write, not crash-atomic persistence.
WAL/rollback recovery, locking/durability semantics, general upsert/delete, Linux and cross-platform gates, and existing-database preservation remain open.
